# Isaiah Chapter 12 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 146v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_012_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**1** You will say in that day: "I will give thanks to you, O LORD, for though you were angry with me, your anger turned away, that you might comfort me.

**2** "Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and he has become my salvation." **3** With joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation.

**4** And you will say in that day: "Give thanks to the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the peoples, proclaim that his name is exalted. **5** Sing praises to the LORD, for he has done gloriously; let this be made known in all the earth. **6** Shout, and sing for joy, O inhabitant of Zion, for great in your midst is the Holy One of Israel."

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah 12 — "Songs of Praise" — part of First Isaiah (chs.1-39), rooted in the 8th-century BCE Assyrian crisis. The chapter contributes to Isaiah's overarching vision: YHWH as the Holy One of Israel who judges his people but promises ultimate restoration.

---

Minor register disagreements resolved through standard SOPHIA consensus process.
